payload.reason: The evidence provides specific competitive results achieved on various datasets, including Wall Street Journal, Hub5'00, and LibriSpeech, indicating the performance of the models.

claims.text: We report competitive results on the Wall Street Journal and Hub5'00 conversational evaluation datasets.
We show competitive results on Wall Street Journal (WSJ) and 2000hr Fisher+Switchboard (F+S).
We achieve state-of-the-art performance on the test-clean subset and SOTA among end-to-end speech recognition models on test-other.
We achieve 2.95% WER using a beam-search decoder with an external neural language model on LibriSpeech test-clean.
